subject: Embeddings priming validation + vector DB fallback runbook
body:
From: Ava Reynolds <ava@searchlytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: eng-team@searchlytics.com
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: priming/seed validation and fallback questions

Thanks for the quick sync this morning, Kimberly — appreciate the time. As discussed, our two immediate risks are: (1) insufficient coverage in the seed set for novelty queries, and (2) the vector DB we selected (VectordbX) shows intermittent reindex lags in staging.

Concrete asks from Searchlytics:
- A short checklist we can run to validate priming/seed quality before a backfill.
- A clear fallback path if vector DB indexing falls behind during the backfill window.
- A sample rerank eval plan we can run in parallel with the backfill.

I attached a seed export and a short list of priority queries. Can your team confirm the timeline for a lightweight priming run and an operator playbook for DB fallback?

Thanks,
Ava
Customer Success Manager
Searchlytics

-----Original Message-----
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Ava Reynolds <ava@searchlytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: priming/seed validation and fallback questions

Hi Ava — thanks for the summary and for the seed export. High-level plan below; details + checklist attached.

Summary plan (this week):
1) Quick priming validation run (48h): sample 10k seed docs -> generate embeddings -> run sample queries (priority list) -> measure recall delta vs. baseline.
2) Backfill staging dry run (72h): run a subset backfill to observe indexing lag characteristics from VectordbX.
3) Rerank eval parallel run: collect top-100 candidates pre-rerank and run the reranker offline against the template you asked for.
4) Fallback playbook: if VectordbX lag > 15 minutes median, we route reads to an in-memory cache + fallback vectorstore (Redwood local ephemeral store) and pause further writes.

Attachments in this thread: priming_validation_checklist.md, rerank_eval_template.xlsx, searchlytics_seed_list_v1.csv

Next steps for you: confirm the staging cluster window (suggest Tue 18 Aug 00:00 - 06:00 UTC) and confirm who will own the DB rollback/failover steps on your side.

I'll coordinate the runbook and will be on-call during the dry run window.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

On Tue, 18 Aug 2026 08:02:14 -0700, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com> wrote:

> Thanks Kim & Ava — quick note from infra: VectordbX in staging has shown a reindex tail at ~2-3x traffic that causes short stalls when we push >50k documents in a 10-minute window. For the dry run I recommend we:
>
> - Chunk writes to 10k batches with 5s spacing
> - Enable indexing telemetry (we'll attach a Grafana dashboard)
> - Keep an automatic pause threshold at 30% queue backlog (operator alert to pause)
>
> I'll attach the staging dashboard and a small script we use to chunk writes. Ben
>
> Attachment: vectordbx_chunker.sh (stub)

On Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:15:45 -0700, Ava Reynolds <ava@searchlytics.com> wrote:

> That sounds great. To confirm: if we hit the pause threshold you recommend, will Redwood provide the ephemeral fallback store and the play-by-play for switching reads? Our infra team can execute steps but we need the exact commands.
>
> Also — for the rerank eval: can you give a quick checklist of acceptance criteria so our PM can sign off after the offline run?
>
> —Ava

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ava Reynolds <ava@searchlytics.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: priming/seed validation and fallback questions

Hi Ava — looping back with the acceptance checklist and runbook snippets (below). We can also drop these into the Drive folder and the HubSpot attachment for the deal.

Rerank eval acceptance criteria (offline):
- Dataset: top-100 candidates sampled across 1k session queries (random stratified by query length).
- Metric targets: NDCG@10 >= 0.72 and MRR increase >= 8% vs baseline reranker.
- Stability: score variance across three runs < 2.5% absolute.
- Latency: offline rerank execution <= 120ms per document on the medium-tier hardware we provision for the eval.

Priming validation quick checklist (extracted):
- Verify seed coverage: no single intent bucket < 1% of seed population. (script: seed_coverage_check.py)
- Sample embeddings: run on 10k sample; check cosine distribution 0.2-0.85; flag <0.05 pairs.
- Query smoke tests: run 50 priority queries; confirm recall@50 >= 0.65.
- Edge-case queries: run 50 novelty queries from the attached list; flag any with zero candidates.

Vector DB fallback runbook (operator steps):
1) Pause writes: POST /admin/backfill/pause -> expect 200
2) Promote ephemeral store: run promote_fallback_store.sh --cluster staging --target ephemeral-01
3) Point read-router to fallback: curl -XPOST https://router.redwood.com/route -d '{"route":"ephemeral-01","ttl":120}'
4) Monitor: ensure read success rate > 98% for 15m; if not, rollback to previous snapshot and open SEV ticket.

Attachments referenced: priming_validation_checklist.md, rerank_eval_template.xlsx, vectordbx_chunker.sh

If you want, we can run a dry rehearsal on Monday and walk your infra through the exact commands.

Kimberly and I will be available during the dry run.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference
